description: This file contains the PHP class 'Activity' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. The class provides methods for managing customer activity logs, such as adding new activities and deleting existing ones from the database.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A model class for managing customer activity logs in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Adds a new activity record for a customer identified by key and data, logging the activity into the database.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records associated with a specific customer ID.
